text:
vp-eng: Thanks for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread: two asks from leadership about the runtime roadmap. 1) Clarify hosted throughput/latency SLO targets for the next quarter. 2) Outline how batching, KV-cache, and kernel changes will be rolled out (canary cadence, health gates, rollback triggers). @maya-eng-runtime @alex-eng-sre

maya-eng-runtime: TL;DR: aiming for p95 token latency <200ms for hosted standard tier (applies to typical web prompt lengths). For Dedicated we target lower variability with p95 <150ms under committed throughput. For rollouts: we'll use staged traffic-weighted canaries per-model-variant: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% with a minimum dwell time per step. Each step must pass health gates before moving on.

alex-eng-sre: Health gates: p95 token-latency change <= +8% vs baseline, error-rate delta <= +0.4% absolute, CPU/GPU memory anomaly detection no new OOMs. Rollback: automated if any gate fails for 1h window, manual rollback if multiple signals degrade intermittently. Canary windows will be at least 24h normally; ops-bot will post schedule. We'll also run parallel shadow traffic to collect correctness diffs.

jamal-ml: Kernel v2 (attn-tiling) shows 1.6-2.0x speedups for long-context (>2048) on our test harness; expect small perf regressions for short-context microbenchmarks due to scheduling overhead. We'll include a model-family matrix in the rollout doc so teams can opt variants per route. Canary next week pending final tests.

sophia-product: Confirming Dedicated customers can pin old variants per-route. We need a concise console blurb and API flag for the opt-out. Also request a short customer-facing note on what "opt-in kernel rollouts" mean for latency and cost.

maya-eng-runtime: Affirmed: Dedicated/reserved customers can pin variants or disable automatic rollouts. Console will show a toggle and a small modal describing tradeoffs. Draft rollout policy snippet for docs: 
```json
{
  "rollout_policy": {
    "steps": [5,20,60,100],
    "min_step_hours": 24,
    "rollback_criteria": {"p95_pct_increase": 8, "error_rate_abs": 0.4}
  }
}
```

ops-bot: scheduled: attn-tiling-v2-canary -> 2025-06-12 04:00 UTC (canary window 48h) :rocket:

vp-eng: Action items: eng-runtime publish rollout doc + model-family matrix by Thu EOD; eng-sre add auto-rollback monitors and runbook; product draft dedicated opt-out UX + customer comms. Please tag me on PRs. :thumbsup:
